Kali displays several cat-like characteristics due to being a cat faunus, such as loving naps, playing with yarn, pats, ear and belly rubs as well as liking to push things off high places and chasing after dots of light. Kali has a lot of love to give, both maternal and romantic, as her daughter has long left home and her husband is both unwilling to give her children and unable to give Kali the romantic and sexual love and attention she desires from him. Despite her energy and desires Kali still moves and acts with a certain weariness due to her age and wrinkles. As a family woman, Kali craves a true loving marriage and a big family full of children.
